notes: Organizations that continued through a rename or a sale, using Jolpica constructorId values. from and to are the seasons that id is listed by Jolpica for that step. to is null when the entry is still active in 2026. The same constructorId can return later in the line (sauber, renault, arrows). A reused id that is a different organization is not linked. Left out on purpose: 1950-1951 Alfa Romeo, 1979-1985 Autodelta, and the 2019-2023 Alfa Romeo name; 1959-1960 Aston Martin and the 2021 Aston Martin entry; 1964-1968 Honda and the 2006-2008 Honda entry; 1954-1955 Mercedes and the 2010 Mercedes entry; the 1977-1985 Renault works team and the Enstone Renault team; Team Lotus, Lotus Racing / Caterham, and Lotus F1; Frank Williams Racing Cars, Iso-Marlboro, and Wolf; the Jolpica id lola, which covers several entrants; and chains that were not established from the pages used here (Osella to Fondmetal, Onyx / Monteverdi, Shadow to Arrows). how_it_ended is worded from the cited English Wikipedia page.
